cards.question_text: Refer to the diagram to answer the following questions.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: Calculate $\angle PQR$ and hence $\angle RQO$ to the nearest degree.

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: Find the length $OR$, correct to one decimal place.

parts.label: c
parts.question_text: If $OR$ is North, find the true bearing of $Q$ from $R$.

cards.question_text:
XYZ represents a triangular area of land.
The bearing of X from Y is $041^{\circ}$ and the bearing of Z from Y is $305^{\circ}$.
The distance XY is $27$ m and the distance YZ is $37$ m.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: What is the size of angle XYZ? Answer correct to the nearest degree.

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: Calculate the area to the nearest square metre.

parts.label: c
parts.question_text: What is the length of the boundary XZ, to the nearest metre?

cards.question_text:
The diagram shows information about the locations of towns P, Q and R.
Amber takes $2$ hours and $30$ minutes to walk directly from Town P to Town Q.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: What is Amber's walking speed, correct to the nearest km/h?

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: What is the distance from P to R? Answer correct to the nearest kilometre.

parts.label: c
parts.question_text: How long would it take Amber to walk from P to R? Answer to the nearest minute.

cards.question_text:
M is $50$ km north of O. The bearing of N from M is $108^{\circ}$ and from O it is $061^{\circ}$.
Answer the following questions to the nearest kilometre.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: What is the distance between M and N?

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: What is the distance between N and O?

cards.question_text:
A ship is located at B and two radar stations $75$ km apart are located at A and C.
The bearing of the ship from one radar station is $038^{\circ}$ and from the other radar station it is $306^{\circ}$.
C is due east of A.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: How far is the ship from the radar station at A, to the nearest kilometre?

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: How far is the ship from the radar station at C, to the nearest kilometre?

cards.question_text:
A salesman drove from town $A$ to town $B$, then to town $C$, then finally directly home to town $A$.
Town B is $67$ km north of town $A$, and the bearings of town $C$ from towns $A$ and $B$ are $039^{\circ}\text{T}$ and $063^{\circ}\text{T}$ respectively.
Find how far the salesman drove, correct to the nearest kilometre.

In the diagram to the right, ship $A$ is $120$ nautical mules from lighthouse $L$ on a bearing of $072^{\circ}\text{T}$, while ship $B$ is $180$ nautical miles from $L$ on a bearing of $136^{\circ}\text{T}$.
Calculate the distance between the two ships, correct to the nearest nautical mile.

A ship sails $53$ nautical miles from $P$ to $Q$ on a bearing of $026^{\circ}\text{T}$.
It then sails $78$ nautical miles due east from $Q$ to $R$.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: Explain why $\angle PQR = 116^{\circ}$.
parts.answer: Draw a north-south line at $Q$, $\angle PQR = 90^{\circ} + 26^{\circ} = 116^{\circ}$ due to alternate angles

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: How far apart are $P$ and $R$, correct to the nearest nautical mile?

cards.question_text:
A yacht sails from $X$ to $Y$ on a bearing of $130^{\circ}$ for $4.2$ km.
It then turns and travels to $Z$ on a bearing of $025^{\circ}$ for $2.9$ km.

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: Explain why $\angle XYZ = 75^{\circ}$.

parts.label: c
parts.question_text: Calculate the distance $XZ$, correct to $1$ d.p.

cards.question_text:
Yorker (Y) is $134$ km due east of Vendor (V).
Xena (X) is on a bearing of $232^{\circ}$ from Yorker and is also $85$ km from Vendor.
$\angle VXY$ is an obtuse angle. Find the bearing of Xena from Vendor.

A ship sails $85$ km from A to B on a bearing of $060^{\circ}\text{T}$.
It then turns and sails $120$ km to C on a bearing of $130^{\circ}\text{T}$.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: Find the size of $\angle ABC$.

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: How far is the ship from its starting point?

parts.label: c
parts.question_text: Calculate $\angle BAC$, to the nearest minute.

parts.label: d
parts.question_text: What is the bearing of the ship from its starting point to the nearest minute?

cards.question_text:
Consider the diagram.
a. Show that the distance $BX$ is $17.9$ km.
b. Show that the distance from $B$ to $X$ via $A$ is $22.2$ km.

The diagram shows the location of three places X, Y and C.
Y is on a bearing of $120^{\circ}$ and $15$ km from X.
C is $40$ km from X and lies due west of Y.
P lies on the line joining C and Y and is due south of X.
a. Find the distance from X to P.
b. What is the bearing of C from X, to the nearest degree?
A ship sails $50$ km from port $A$ to port $B$ on a bearing of $063^{\circ}\text{T}$, then sails $130$ km from port B to port C on a bearing of $296^{\circ}\text{T}$.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: Show that $\angle ABC = 53^{\circ}$.

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: Find, correct to the nearest km, the distance of port A from port $C$.

parts.label: c
parts.question_text: Find $\angle ACB$, and hence find the bearing of port $A$ from port $C$, correct to the nearest degree.

cards.question_text: A motorist drove $70$ km from town A to town B on a bearing of $056^{\circ}\text{T}$, and then drove $90$ km from town B to town C on a bearing of $146^{\circ}\text{T}$.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: Explain why $\angle ABC = 90^{\circ}$.

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: How far apart are the towns A and C, correct to the nearest kilometre?

parts.label: c
parts.question_text: Find $\angle BAC$, and hence find the bearing of town C from town A, to the nearest degree.

cards.question_text:
The diagram shows an aeroplane that was flying towards an airport at $A$ on a bearing of $135^{\circ}\text{T}$.
When it was at point $O$, $20$ km away from the airport at $A$, the flight course was changed.
The aeroplane landed at an airport at $B$ directly south of $O$. The distance from $O$ to $B$ is $50$ km.
a. Show that the distance between airport $A$ and airport $B$ is $38.5$ km, correct to $1$ d.p.
b. Find $\angle OBA$ to the nearest degree.
c. What is the bearing of the airport at $B$ from the airport at $A$?

A vertical tower TC is $40$ metres high. The point A is due east of the base of the tower C.
The angle of elevation to the top T of the tower from A is $35^{\circ}$.
A second point B is on a different bearing from the tower as shown.
The angle of elevation to the top of the tower from B is $30^{\circ}$.
The points A and B are $100$ metres apart.
a. Show that distance AC is $57.13$ metres, correct to $2$ decimal places.
b. Find the bearing of B from C to the nearest degree.

From two points $P$ and $Q$ on level ground, the angles of elevation of the top $T$ of a $38$ m tower are $26^{\circ}$ and $22^{\circ}$ respectively.
Point $P$ is due south of the tower, and the bearing of $Q$ from the tower is $100^{\circ}\text{T}$.

parts.label: a
parts.question_text: Show that $PB = 38\tan 64^{\circ}$, and find a similar expression for $QB$.

parts.label: b
parts.question_text: Hence determine, correct to the nearest metre, the distance between $P$ and $Q$.

cards.question_text:
Two observers at $A$ and $B$ on horizontal ground are $300$ m apart.
From $A$, the angle of elevation of the top $C$ of a tall building $DC$ is $32^{\circ}$.
It is also known that $\angle DAB = 59^{\circ}$ and $\angle ADB = 78^{\circ}$.
a. Show that $AD = \dfrac{300\sin 43^{\circ}}{\sin 78^{\circ}}$.
b. Hence find the height of the building, correct to the nearest metre.

A cube ABCDEFGH is pictured below. R, S, and T are the midpoints of AB, FG and EH as shown. Side length = $10$.
Calculate the size of the angle TRS, giving your answer to one decimal place.

A tower is built on flat ground.
Three tourists, A, B and C are observing the tower from ground level.
A is due north of the tower, C is due east and B is on the line of sight from A to C and between them.
The angles of elevation of the top of the tower from A, B and C are $26^{\circ}$, $28^{\circ}$ and $30^{\circ}$, respectively.
What is the bearing of B from the tower?
